notes.title: Update 0.0.4: Pet Egg Requirements and Cherry
notes.content: [h2]Hello to all fishies and fishers!!!![/h2][p][/p][h3]I finally got the second part of the egg mechanic for the game done. [/h3][p]It's still super early in its progress, so don't expect a super crazy thing with this. But for starters, this mechanic will introduce the actual requirements to start hatching pets. In the previous update it was just building the egg, but now we have requirements!! All levels in the game where you unlock a pet have this feature now and are also all unique. Take for example Mary, her egg requires you to have a few baby guppys within the tank, plus another requirement, to hatch.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325382/50afe759ed92832d49a6806e06c8e9d1cf8da59f.gif"][/img][/p][p](Just figured out how to make gifs ;p)[/p][p][/p][p]This will help with making each level feel unique, even though you're still doing the same thing on a surface level. But aside from the new pet egg requirements, this update introduces a new pet. Say hello to Cherry!![/p][p][/p][p]Cherry is a quahog clam, or in other words a cherrystone clam. She is a simple pet, she sits at the bottom of your tank and occasionally produces pearls. Each pearl is worth 255 money or about 12 Guppys. She also has a pretty interesting ability too, you can grab her and move her around the tank. She doesn't mind it, and if you want, you can drop her from the top of the tank. She also weighs a bit, but that's just her shell's weight. But with this extra shell weight, she can stun enemies with it. Just drop her on top of enemies and watch them get stunned. [/p][p][/p][p]Just note, this will not be the final look/build for Cherry. I plan on completely changing her look in the future. At least I plan on updating her sprite to be built 3d-ish. I think I have an idea for creating all assets for the game, just need to figure out a good approach to this idea. But the overall idea of her being a clam with pearl making abilities + basic crowd control will be her identity. [/p][p][/p][p]OHH,[/p][p]Here she is giving you a pearl!!![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45325382/a9097c1c088f8b0765746e4ee79057a3e36bda4f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][u]As for final notes, here are the patch notes:[/u] [/h3][list][*][p]Added Pet Descriptions to post game, now you know what each pet does, kinda...[/p][/*][*][p]Added Pet Sprites to post game, now you know what they look like, kinda...[/p][/*][*][p]Added Pet Egg Requirements for hatching, now their is a phase 2 to beat[/p][/*][*][p]Made tutorial text pop up always pause game[/p][/*][*][p]Hatched Egg are now out of the way when Text is available to read.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Egg Piece's mask interacting with each others[/p][/*][*][p]Egg Pieces and Guppys now spawn randomly at top of tank[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Enemy fish colliders to be easier to click on during charges[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Egg Pieces being able to be dragged off screen (kills ability to finish level)[/p][/*][*][p]Added New Pet Cherry !!!! Finallyyy[/p][/*][*][p]Added new level to clear to unlock Cherry from (1-5)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a play button to make it easier to progress to level in main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added First iteration of income system[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth="25"][tr][td rowspan="13" colwidth="25"][p][/p][/td][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][tr][/tr][/table]

notes.title: 0.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Welcome back to another update of my favorite game to code. 
Even though I tank forever to come out with update. 

I did just start a new job at the start of this year. I was not expecting it to drain my soul dry to the point I can't even work on anything outside. Hopefully it gets better but who knows.
This will slow game dev  progress by some. So instead of by-monthly it might be tri-monthly.

As for the actual update, I didn't really add a whole lot, this is more of a small update. Mostly behind a behind the scenes update for me but I wanted to push this now since Easter is starting today and this update was inspired by Easter in general. This is the introduction to Egg Assembly. If you thought that buying the egg pieces was too simple of a task in Insaniaquarium, now its time to start actually assembling the eggs. *In a future update I will include the requirement you will need to hatch them. Which should create some fun unique little puzzles for each level. 

There's going to be a new direction I'm pushing the art towards. I'm dropping the pixelated look for the game since I couldn't really convey to much with that art-style with what I was trying to do. Instead I'm going to try a canvas painted art style that can express a bit more. I might change it again but this will be what I want to be using moving forward. This new art style also fits with the Insaniaquarium Vibe, since they kinda do this style throughout the game. I see it most with the tank backgrounds. I plan to slowly transition some of the fish into the new style as well. I'm still figuring out how to animate them as a 2d sprite. Its kinda hard to explain but want to animate them as a flat fish that is animated in 3d. Kinda like Wii Play fishing mini game. 

Anyways that's my rant about the current state of the game.
Here's the Update patch notes. 

[list]
[*] Fixed diamond money value, it was way too much
[*] Fixed Guppy start hunger being to high.
[*] Dialogue box hides when esc menu is open'd
[*] Guppys now visably grow instead of instantly + sf
[*] Added other sound effects 
[*] Added Egg puzzel as part of the main objective
[*] Added Pet Egg sprites for each pet
[*] Fixed Certain Guppies not aging when bought between certain tutorial sequences
[*] Added Egg Puzzel info into tutorial (1-1)
[*] Moved Enemy tutorial info into its own tutorial (1-2)
[*] Fixed guppy purchace transactions still going through even if spawnables max was reached
[*] Fixed tutorial text not gettting typed out on certain paused events
[*] Fixed tutorial text box sometimes not closing on esc menu interaction
[*] Sped up tutorial text, it felt to slow before. 
[*] Fish food now displays how much it takes from you per spawn
[/list]



If you have any questions or complaints just message me on discord or what ever. Discord link should be right below this message or in the store page. you never know with steam.

notes.title: 0.0.2 update
notes.content:
Hello fishi people

This is the first update for the game, post demo release. I hope this can be seen from the demo, if not welp. As for the update, this update is centered around upgrading the existing systems in the game. The biggest change people will notice is that we have a new fish tank! I've finally had the chance to upgrade the fish tank to look similar to the game cover one; Instead of having the old depressing fish tank of before. I do still need to work on updating the rest of the assets, but still is an achievement that I am proud off. I also introduced shaders into the game. I hope they don't take too big of a hit on the performance. Now that I think of it, I might add a toggle for the shaders just in case. But in the [b]next [/b]update. 

As for other changes, I added a patch notes list below.
The majority of the list entails tutorial related updates. Pretty much the whole update was visuals and tutorial upgrade, and starfish logic update. So I name thee, "The Tutorial Update + some". I do still want to update the tutorial a bit more. I'm thinking of adding some more alternative texts and adding a post game tutorial to show you around. But that might have to wait for now. 

[list]
[*]Added text pop up when player clicks coins
[*]Updated coin values 
[*]Updated Starfish enemy ai, easier to hit when they are charging
[*]Added Counters mechanic, Enemies now take double damage from them
[*]Updated tank to use water shaders
[*]Added a ripple effect into the game (for special moments)
[*]Updated tank scenery 
[*]Updated Tutorial, made it harder to lose on tutorial, if your first guppy starves, insurance covers it
[*]Also made it so you can't buy what ever you feel like from the shop now, you have to unlock them through out the tutorial. ;p
[*]Also fixed some bugs in the tutorial where some triggers would not be noticed by the tutorial, causing you to just have nothing to do
[*]Also, also, also re ordered some of the tutorial, for pacing
[*]Fixed hella bugs with the tutorial and esc menu interactions (theres still 1 more but its not urgent)
[*]Fixed tooltip not updating when we buy egg pieces in the shop
[*]Added a visual when something is purchased from the shop
[*]Increased time it takes for enemies to spawn in when the game starts
[*]Enemies now drop a gem when killed
[/list]


Also join the discord if you have any questions or ideas to add to the game. 
The link is attached to this post below.

notes.title: Project - Fish Shop Demo is now Live!
notes.content:
Hello to all of my beautiful Guppys!

I’m excited to announce that my game is now ready to be released as a demo on Steam! Since the original game jam version, I’ve made several updates to improve the game. If you’d like to check out the original version, you can find it here:
https://meowwfruit.itch.io/project-fish-shop

For each major update, I’ll be giving it a specific title. Since this is my first release on Steam, I’m calling this update the "Steam Update." Below, you'll find the patch notes outlining what's new.

If you're new to the game—or if this is your first time playing—why not join the Discord server? Even if it’s just to say "Hi!" I launched the game alongside the Discord to help build a community that can help shape the game into something worth buying. 
  


[b]'Steam Release' Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added pets to the game, welcome Charlie, Mary, Salt and Khalid to the tank, as friendly pet helpers!
[*]Each pet is unlocked post level completion
[*]Removed gems mechanic from the game
[*]Removed the ability to grab guppys in the game (for now)
[*]Updated guppy swimming
[*]Updated Main Menu and Levels selection screen
[*]Added Pets selection screen to Main Menu
[*]You can now save the game to file
[*]Added new game option as well
[*]Enemies now get knocked back and reset their momentums
[*]Enemies now bounce off tank wall instead of glitching out of tank if you keep spamming into the walls
[*]Guppy's whole body now gets transparent when hungry instead of just the body
[*]Tank Camera perspective slightly changed
[*]Updated coin sprites
[*]Updated food sprite
[*]Added two new food upgrades, green pellet and pill pellet
[*]Updated Tank to have a more home-ee feeling
[*]Updated tank UI
[*]Updated esc menu in levels
[*]Updated Tutorial to teach player about mechanics
[*]Updated Large Mouth Bass enemy ai logic to keep moving around tank even without guppys in tank
[*]Starfish enemy now can be clicked in the middle of charging + dashing
[*]Added tooltip to game (when hovering/selecting pets + when hovering shop)
[*]Added Steam Integration
[*]Added 3 more levels to match with current unlockable pet roster (4)
[*]You can now do screenshots in game levels with 'P'
[*]Added level complete screen after beating level
[*]Level complete screen now shows post game stats
[*]Pets now swim in the background in main menu
[*]Quit button now works
[/list]


I am also going to add bug fixes here as well since these were added along with this first release version

0.0.1.a Patch Notes: 
[list]
[*]Fixed how final time is displayed (previously displayed seconds wrong)
[*]Updated Save check if our old save file needs to be updated
[*]Fixed some levels having wrong start money
[*]Fixed pet Salt logic, Salt can now only have one salt pellet active
[*]Fixed Salt charge build not resetting
[*]Fixed Salt-pellet leaving tank (and guppys chasing after it)
[*]Mary now spawns a new guppy way slower
[/list]

0.0.1.b Patch Notes:
[list]
[*]Discord and Bluesky are now in main menu, now you can join the discord server from the game!
[/list]
